authorizationBoundary.provenance: Verified coordinator relay reported by the delegating parent; this review does not claim a new native human readback.
authorizationBoundary.interpretation: Necessary diagnosed future corrections and independently reviewed finite successors may be prepared without repeating an owner permission question. Standing permission does not alter installed budgets, permit generic retries, refund attempts, reset history, or grant an unlimited execution flag.

designDisposition.conclusion: The architecture acknowledged by the implementation owner resolves the design concerns raised in this review. This is not approval of evolving implementation bytes, R6 activation, consumer execution, or independent Product Experience review seven.
designDisposition.requiredNextReview: Review the exact frozen authority/runtime/schema/tests/record diff and source bindings after focused synthetic regressions; use existing protected authority qualification before consumer execution.

requiredImplementationChecks.requirement: Install an exact finite R6 record with capture17/review7/authenticated submission3/ordinary2; preserve all predecessor records, capture16 and blocked review6 bytes, all earlier consumed attempts and the existing expiry. R5 unused slots are not borrowed or revived. Failure/cancellation consumes the relevant R6 slot. A future correction requires a separately reviewed finite successor, not an R6 refund or generic history exclusion.

Use a create-only marker keyed to the fixed R6 grant ID in the independent repository common Git directory. Consume before build/browser work. STARTED, failure, cancellation, or missing terminal receipt remain consumed across worktrees and changed candidate tuples. Read-only source/history admission may precede consumption. No reset/delete/refund API. Clearly describe this as local operator accounting, not authenticated global invocation custody.

Freeze exact authorized two contract annotations and two existing paired specs before grant pinning; no product source, public assets, Prisma, dependency, or runtime-configuration expansion. Protected preparation admission requires source-bound successful committed local preflight receipt and media for the same execution inputs. Later documentation/evidence-only descendants must preserve executed candidate SHA/tree, ancestry, exact runtime/test/config/contract inputs, and fixed protected base; never rewrite the receipt tuple or rely on productSourceDigest equality alone.

Reuse the existing browser-authority owned production runtime and supervised external-server Playwright phase after the generic capture child. Do not create a second server, independent acceptance path, or token-bearing child. Preserve existing cancellation, ownership, lease, and bounded cleanup semantics.

Compile exactly three canonical paired case IDs once, referenced by both affected contracts. Require exact no-retry successful cases with two distinct participating surfaces per case, no skipped/flaky/duplicate/extra cases, forced intended browser project, repeatEach1, retries0 and bounded worker/runtime settings. Parent manifest validation must reject missing cases, duplicate case execution, wrong viewport or motion, wrong fixture/Voyage/edition, or mismatched source/stage identity.

Validate actual case observations for real Join, two distinct surfaces on the same synthetic Voyage/edition, sender/receiver Receive and canonical ACK ordering after visible content, adverse privacy and recovery, and actual Continue with the intended same-Voyage progression outcome in both normal and reduced-motion cases. Retain existing person/membership/privacy assertions. Scenario labels or assertion-free outcome booleans are not sufficient evidence.

Each paired case must await trace completion, context closure, video flush and owned fixture removal; failure cannot be swallowed. Publish its successful witness only after those steps complete. Trusted parent attaches successful final profile/runtime/process/port cleanup only after browser-authority returns. A missing terminal witness on cancellation rejects success while preserving partial diagnostics/media. Per-case fixture cleanup does not substitute for runtime cleanup.

Preparation currently invokes replay with validateReplay:false. New paired completeness, media integrity, source binding and cleanup validation must still run unconditionally before successful capture manifest or activation output. Generic experience replay acceptance may remain deferred to independent review; missing paired evidence may not.

Make paired obligations first-class preserved/digested fields in canonical contract merge and plan generation. Bind pairedEvidence and referenced hashed media into capture artifacts, both affected review packets, sealed review identity, candidate-versus-capture attestation equality, central evidence validation and ordinary replay validation. Both packets reference the same three canonical cases; do not execute those cases twice because two contracts cite them.

Require actual PNG/video/trace for each of six participating contexts, finalized before hashing. Normalize and validate paths under the real invocation-owned output root; reject stale artifacts, traversal, absolute-path or symlink escapes, wrong type, missing bytes, hash mismatch and mismatched source/fixture/stage nonce. Preserve the accepted viewport-only behavior and existing secret/code/QR masking without weakening the visible interaction proof. Use synthetic fixtures only.

Disclose six paired contexts for local preflight, thirty-eight contexts for preparation, three paired cases among the ordinary mandatory six-suite technical work, and thirty-eight contexts for ordinary Product Experience replay. The paired producer executes three cases at each of four stages, twelve pair cases/twenty-four paired contexts in total, plus sixty-four generic contexts and all other technical suite activity. Thirty-eight is a full Product Experience pass count, not the total campaign count. Do not suppress mandatory suites or silently substitute technical execution for reviewed Product Experience evidence.

Focused non-consumer regressions must reject absent/extra/duplicate/failed/retried paired cases; malformed outcome/media/source/cleanup receipts; artifact path/hash/type violations; cleanup errors and cancellation; lost paired schema through plan merge; altered paired evidence at seal/attestation; stale or reused local markers; failed preflight attempting protected capture; historical/expired/retired grant fallback. A final frozen source review and protected qualification remain separate from these synthetic tests and later independent product review.
